 Yogi Adityanath’s mother Savitri Devi dies, Uttarakhand CM Dhami expresses condolences
 BJP UP chief Pankaj Chaudhary, too, condoled the demise and said party leaders were trying to reach the family.

 Dehradun: Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath’s mother, Savitri Devi, has passed away, Uttarakhand Chief Minister Pushkar Singh Dhami said on Thursday while expressing grief over her demise. In a post on X, Dhami described her passing as “deeply saddening and heart-wrenching” and said that a mother’s affection, blessings and love are among the most precious assets in one’s life.
 “The news of the passing of Smt. Savitri Devi ji, the revered mother of the Honourable Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh, Shri Yogi Adityanath ji, is deeply saddening and heart-wrenching. A mother’s affection, blessings, and love are the most precious assets in one’s life,” he wrote. He said her demise was an irreparable loss for the family and prayed to Baba Kedar to grant a place at His divine feet to the departed soul. “Her departure is an irreparable loss for the family,” he further wrote.
 Dhami also prayed for strength for Yogi Adityanath and other bereaved family members to endure the immense grief. “I pray to Baba Kedar to grant a place at His divine feet to the departed soul and to bestow upon the Honourable Yogi ji and all the bereaved family members the strength to endure this immense grief,” Dhami added.
Meanwhile, Union Minister of State for Finance and BJP UP Chief, Pankaj Chaudhary also expressed grief.
 Show Full Article
 “Very sad news has been received. And certainly, that is why we… since the program had already started, we did not do the informal welcoming that usually takes place. We also held a brief condolence, and all of us are currently trying to reach their place,” he said.
